title: metadata: the in-memory registry and the artifact door's MemoryLoader keep one member per (package, name), so a bundled type's second locale is lost on the metadata service's own reads (N9)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CX9R5BLZwgJDeivmA7

Split out of #32488 (item 2, N9) by the epic seat `epic:#31527#1` ruling A (session `session_01Utp6CYGYEUhpi29FpjLmxT`, seat thread, 2026-11-12): "This PR carries items 1 (R7-C) and 3 (R8-A) only, with `Fixes #32488`. You file the N9 card (two layers: the MetadataManager registry and MemoryLoader, keyed with the member dimension) as a sub-issue of #31527, p2, `Blocked-by:` this PR." It also absorbs closed #32459 (folded into N9 by the same seat's ruling A). Part of #31527 (ADR-0150).

Blocked-by: #32488

## 维护者速读

- 改什么：metadata 服务自己的内存注册表和制品门的 MemoryLoader，都按 (包, 名) 只留一项，打包类型（如邮件模板）的第二种语言在这两层被盖掉。
- 为什么：同包两种语言的模板，metadata 服务自己的 list/loadMany/loadManyKeyed 只答最后存的那一种。
- 风险：对外面全部两种语言都在（GET /meta、发信用的执行面、?package= 两面、SchemaRegistry）；没找到这几条有损读法的消费者。属于加固。
- 先看：`MetadataManager` 的注册表键（`storeSlotKey` / `admitLoaderSlots`）与 `MemoryLoader.save` 的槽。
- 验证：同包两种语言 register / save 后，metadata 服务的 list 两种都答；CONTROL：非打包类型每槽仍一项。
- 需要你做的：无，归 server 车道。

## The defect

Measured at PR #32214's final head `27abd458a8` by the #32459 card thread (`createStandaloneStack` + artifact door + hot reload, one artifact shipping `pz_mail` in `en-US` and `fr-FR`), and on `main` by the #32488 card thread:

| Surface | Locales served |
|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/email_template` (`protocol.getMetaItems`) | both |
| `protocol.getMetaItemsForExecution` (the email send path) | both |
| both reads with `packageId` | both |
| ObjectQL `SchemaRegistry.listItems` | both |
| metadata service `list` / `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed` | **one** (the last saved) |

The member is lost in two layers (enumerated in #32488 comment 6812707392):

1. `MetadataManager`'s in-memory registry (`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts`): `register` twice (two locales, one package) leaves one `(package, name)` key. A write naming no package lands in the one holder's slot (D4).
2. `MemoryLoader.save` (`packages/metadata/src/loaders/memory-loader.ts`): its slot holds one item per `(package, name)`. Keying only this layer changes nothing on `metadata.list`, because `admitLoaderSlots` keys loader entries by `storeSlotKey` (package, name) and the registry's slot shadows both loader members.

Expected: each member of a bundled type is readable as its own member on the metadata service's reads, as #32214 does for `DatabaseLoader`.

reach: no consumer of the lossy reads found for `email_template` (callers of `loadMany`: `_loadFromFileSystem`, objectql `loadMetadataFromService` for object/view/app/flow/hook only, action/hook binders). First-party served surfaces: 0 affected.

## Do

1. Re-measure on `main` after #32488 lands, for every bundled type (take the list from the tree).
2. Key both layers by `(package, name, member)` for bundled types; touch get/remove/refusal (`storeRemovalKeys`, `refuseSeveralSlots`, `lastWrittenOf`) on the D3/D4 path as needed. Estimate 400–700 lines.
3. Pins: both locales on `metadata.list` / `loadMany` / `loadManyKeyed`; CONTROL: an unbundled type keeps one item per slot. Ablate once.

**Clause-②:** expected `no` (internal reads gain a member); the claimer declares it after measuring.
**Business reason:** the metadata service's own reads of a two-language template answer one language; a future consumer would silently lose a locale.

Dedupe (`registry member dimension`, `MemoryLoader locale overwrite`, `one entry per (package, name) bundled`): #32488 item 2 (split out here), #32459 (closed not planned, folded here).
Grade: p2 (no served surface affected, no stored data lost).
